title: Advisee GPA distribution
description: A pie, donut or bar chart of how many of the advisor's advisees fall into each GPA range (four one-point ranges, eight half-point ranges, two halves 0–2 and 2–4, or above and below a 2.5, 3.0 or 3.5 cut-off), with counts and shares. Selecting a range lists those advisees with their GPAs, and selecting a name opens that advisee.

options.pie: A pie chart, when the request asks for a pie chart or for shares of the whole
options.donut: A donut chart with the total in the centre, when the request asks for a donut or ring chart
options.bars: Horizontal bars, when the request asks for a bar chart, histogram, or to compare counts precisely

options.two: Two ranges split at 2.0: 0–2 and 2–4 (below and above a 2.0 GPA)
options.cut-2-5: Two ranges split at 2.5: 0–2.5 and 2.5–4 (below and above a 2.5 GPA)
options.cut-3: Two ranges split at 3.0: 0–3 and 3–4 (below and above a 3.0 GPA)
options.cut-3-5: Two ranges split at 3.5: 0–3.5 and 3.5–4 (below and above a 3.5 GPA)

options.all: Every advisee, whenever the request does not narrow who is counted
options.flagged: Only advisees with at least one risk flag such as holds, low credits or conflicts

origin.request: give me a pie chart of the amount of students with gpa's between 0-2 and 2-4
